description: This file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class LocationEmployeeCount within the OrangeHRM Dashboard plugin, representing the employee count data for a specific location, including location ID, name, and employee count.

classes.name: LocationEmployeeCount
classes.description: A DTO class encapsulating location ID, name, and employee count for dashboard reporting purposes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the location ID, name, and employee count.

methods.name: getLocationId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the location.

methods.name: getLocationName
methods.description: Returns the name of the location.

methods.name: getEmployeeCount
methods.description: Returns the number of employees at the location.
